reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: This is my repurchase. It’s convenient as I do not need to use my hand. It absorbs oil, sometimes will take a way a bit of my make up but acceptable
reviews.zh: 呢個係我回購。好方便，唔使用手。佢會吸油，不過有時會帶走少少妝，但可以接受。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: It has a nice big sized mirror inside. I like that it has an applicator so I don't have to touch the paper myself. I like that it comes with 1 refill.
reviews.zh: 入面有一面好大嘅鏡子。我鍾意佢有取紙器，唔使自己用手觸碰吸油紙。我鍾意佢附送一個補充裝。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: There are better blotting sheets out there. Worth a try, but it doesn't really help in controlling my oils unlike other brands.
reviews.zh: 市面上有更好嘅吸油紙。值得一試，但係同其他品牌唔同，佢對控油嘅幫助唔算大。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: Bought these as a part of a kit I made for myself for renewing sunscreen over makeup during the day. They are the first step, taking off a bit of sweat and skin oiliness before applying spf. Great packaging, love it!
reviews.zh: 我買呢款，係為咗自己組合嘅一套日間喺妝面上補擦防曬嘅套裝之一。佢係第一步，用嚟吸走少少汗水同皮膚油脂，然後先塗防曬。包裝好好，好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: I’ve used this while wearing makeup and it’s gentle enough where it doesn’t lift my makeup off. I also like how it comes with a mirror it’s very convenient
reviews.zh: 我化妝嗰陣用過，佢夠溫和，唔會令我嘅妝容脫落。我亦鍾意佢附有鏡子，非常方便。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: Pretty good product, it's my first time using oil paper. It really absorbs the oiliness I get throughout the day. Hoping to get more refills next time.
reviews.zh: 幾好用嘅產品，呢個係我第一次用吸油紙。佢真係可以吸走我成日出嘅油。希望下次可以買多啲補充裝。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: I really enjoying theses oil blotting compacts. They're so easy to use and great to take on the go. I just wish they would sell the individual refills as well.
reviews.zh: 我真係好享受呢啲吸油紙盒。好易用，外出攜帶都好方便。我只係希望佢哋都可以單獨出售補充裝。

reviews.shade: Fillimilli No Sebum Oil Control Paper (Original Product 50P+Refill 50P) (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: This is very convenient with a mirror in the compact. The puff has a sticker that allows you to pick up blotting paper without your fingers.
reviews.zh: 粉盒入面有鏡子，非常方便。個粉撲有塊貼紙，可以唔使用手指拎起吸油紙。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
